info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Waitlists-v5-spec
info.description: The List Education Enrollments Waitlists API provides access to current waitlist information for educational enrollments. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of students who are currently on waitlists, facilitating better management of enrollment processes. Typical consumers include educational institutions, administrators, and developers building applications that require visibility into enrollment capacities. This API aims to enhance decision-making regarding student admissions and resource allocation.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of students on the waitlist for enrollment.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current list of students who are on the waitlist for enrollment. This information can help administrators understand enrollment demand and manage waitlist priorities effectively.
